title: listera smallii
intro: Listera smallii, commonly known as Small's twayblade, is a type of orchid that belongs to the Listera genus. This terrestrial orchid is native to North America and is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Listera smallii include its ability to support the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial activity, making it a potential remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
